svg.text: Spatial-Aware Machine Learning & Multi-Criteria Siting Framework for Smart EV Charging Infrastructure (52,718 Stations)

g.text: Spatial Graph Feature Engineering & Topological Enrichment Pipeline
Explainable AI (TreeSHAP) & Actionable Counterfactual Optimization Sub-Network
Immutable coordinates (Lat/Lon) held constant (δ_j = 0) • Actionable levers (feeder lines, road transitions, POI density) minimized via L1-norm Nelder-Mead simplex
Stations located > 5 km from highway suffer substantial negative SHAP penalties (-0.124),
which can be neutralized by connecting to primary dual-carriageway corridors.
• Actionable Set: Feeder headroom, POI mix, road type
• Elevation: Transitions AC slow (18%) to DC fast (82%)
Solves for minimal infrastructure delta: e.g. upgrading transformer tap + adding
retail amenities yields fast charging suitability without expensive land relocation.
• AHP Weights: w = [30% Adopt, 25% Grid, 25% NH, 20% Gap]
• Euclidean Ideal Distance in 4-Dimensional Normalized Space
• Partitions All 36 States/UTs into 3 Policy Priority Tiers
Tier 1: High Priority (KA, MH, UP, DL, TN, RJ, KL, GJ, MP, TS)
Guides central FAME-II and PM E-DRIVE public fund disbursement.
Empirical Results, Diagnostic Visuals & National Siting
